categories.manip_static_locked: base parked, column and bend held still: arms and grippers only
categories.manip_static: base parked: arms, grippers, column and bend
categories.locomotion: driving the base; arms idle (may carry something)

tasks.task: Pick up the bottle and paper ball from the table and place them in the rear-left bin on the robot's base.
Clean the desk using the microfiber tool.
Remove the empty filament spool and place it in the robot's base.
Place a new filament spool onto the spool holder.
Insert the filament into the extruder.
Clean the round cafeteria table.
Clean the cafeteria counter.
Clean the cafeteria high table.
Clean the cafeteria high chair.
Spray the sink with cleaning solution.
Scrub the sink.
Spray the toilet with cleaning solution.
Scrub the entire toilet.
Press the toilet flush button.
Prusa – 3D Printer — Remove the PEI plate
Prusa – 3D Printer — Place the PEI plate back onto the 3D printer
Clean the desk
Pick up the microfiber tool, wipe all coffee stains off the desk, then place the tool back on the table and release it.
Desk cleaning — Pick up the microfiber tool, wipe all crumbs off the desk, then place the tool back on the table and release it.
Pick up the microfiber tool from the right box of the wheeled platform. Place it on the desk. Release it.
Pick up and place the 4 plastic corners in their designated positions, one by one.
Pick up the flat metal plate and place it on the 4 plastic corners, aligning the screw holes.
Pick up and insert 8 screws into the designated holes of the bottom plate, one by one.
Pick up the microfiber tool, wipe all crumbs and coffee stains off the desk, then place the tool back on the table and release it.
Clean the table. Also clean any stains or crumbs you see
Pick up the microfiber tool by its handle. Flip it first if upside down.
Grab the visible trash from the table and place it in the back left bin in the base.
